description: This source file defines a data class and a composable function for managing the state of a Base64-encoded image in an Android application using Jetpack Compose. It handles decoding the Base64 string into an image and maintains whether decoding has failed.

classes.name: Base64ImageState
classes.description: Data class holding an ImageBitmap and a failure flag indicating decoding failure.

methods.name: rememberBase64ImageState
methods.description: A composable function that maintains and manages the decoding state of a Base64 string into an image.
